November Mountain, March Garden

SSF-MS6-L2-6501000-MSELA6-FFR-LAT · MS ELA Grade 6 · Introduce and Organize Claims and Reasons
THE DIRECTIONS
You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.
The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.
The report page
As you record, the four reasons fill in. Say your claim first, then give them in time order.

4 SEEN

EARLIESTLATEST
THE SCENE
You are the one who tells the school news what will happen next. You are alone in the library and your report page is empty. This week you say if the monarch butterflies will come back to our garden. That one sentence about next spring is your claim. Four reasons go under it, and four people each have one.
THE HISTORY
These butterflies spend every winter in Michoacán, Mexico. They rest in tall trees high on the mountain. They arrive in early November, at Día de los Muertos. People there have counted them every year for a long time.
